_about: Milestone 9 brief, Interfaces "MCP (crates/mcp)": every tool of the orchestrator and the sub-planner, and the worker's task_note, as the table gives them. Built from the table alone, independently of the Rust schemas it checks. Milestone 9.3 decision 29 (task M9.3.7) adds edit_plan's iterate (string, 1 to 16,384 characters) and the orchestrator's seventh tool, start_goal, from that decision's text; edit_plan requires nothing, since the daemon reads a missing edits as an empty batch (task M9.3.7's fix round 1). Milestone 9.6 (task M9.6.6, Interfaces "MCP tools" and decisions 17 and 20) adds plan_task's covers (at most 32 ids, each matching ^R[0-9]+$, at most 8 characters), edit_plan's responses (at most 40 {id, answer}), the orchestrator's start_brainstorm, submit_doc and get_doc, a brainstormer's submit_doc and a document reviewer's get_doc and submit_findings. Task M9.6.10 adds the document reviewer's get_doc draft (a spec's review draft, an integer of at least 1, ruling T5-1), which the orchestrator's get_doc does not take. Task M9.6.11 (ruling T11-1) adds spawn_subplanner's optional covers (as plan_task's): the requirement ids the epic owns. Milestone 9.9 (task M9.9.7, decision 15) adds the orchestrator's eleventh tool, ask_user, from that decision's text.

orchestrator.name: get_context
orchestrator.description: Read the run's context: the repository profile, the role table (which model each size runs on), the limits, scout reports, epics and the plan so far.

orchestrator.name: spawn_scout
orchestrator.description: Start a read-only scout on one area with one question. Returns at once; its report appears in run_status and get_context.

orchestrator.name: spawn_subplanner
orchestrator.description: Start a sub-planner for one epic with its own area, or a fresh one to re-plan an existing epic. Returns at once.

orchestrator.name: edit_plan
orchestrator.description: Apply plan edits as one batch. Set submit to open the plan gate. Add a summary for the user when the run is complete. Set iterate, with no edits and nothing else, to start a round the user asked for. retry, override, resume_run, approve_hold and accept_red each come alone, with a reason. approve_hold never approves a promoted run's promotion hold: that is the user's plan approval. Returns at once.

route.description: Ignored: models come from the role table.

orchestrator.name: run_status
orchestrator.description: Read the run digest. With since and wait_secs, wait up to wait_secs seconds (at most 50) for it to change.

orchestrator.name: task_result
orchestrator.description: Read everything about one task: brief, commits, diff size, checks, proofs, reviews, agent rounds and any report.

orchestrator.name: start_goal
orchestrator.description: Start a new goal on this orchestrator when the user gives you one; only while your last run has ended.

orchestrator.name: start_brainstorm
orchestrator.description: Start the two brainstormers with the user's answers to your questions (empty if they skipped). Only in the brainstorming phase. Returns at once.

orchestrator.name: submit_doc
orchestrator.description: Submit a design document: the merged brainstorm report (kind brainstorm) or the spec (kind spec). A spec with ready false goes to review; with ready true it opens the gate, and responses must answer every finding of the latest review.

orchestrator.name: get_doc
orchestrator.description: Read a design document: the latest of a kind, one version, or a brainstormer's draft (from).

orchestrator.name: ask_user
orchestrator.description: Ask the user one question when only they can decide, with up to nine short options and the context they need. Returns at once; their choice arrives as a message. Once the plan is approved, never ask in chat instead.

planner.name: get_context
planner.description: Read the run's context: the repository profile, the role table (which model each size runs on), the limits, scout reports, epics and the plan so far.

planner.name: submit_epic
planner.description: Submit your epic's tasks as one batch of plan edits. If it returns errors, fix them and call it again. When it is accepted you are done.

route.description: Ignored: models come from the role table.
Ignored: models come from the role table.
Ignored: models come from the role table.

worker.name: task_note
worker.description: Report a discovery, risk or progress without blocking the task.

brainstormer.name: submit_doc
brainstormer.description: Submit your brainstorm draft (kind brainstorm_draft) in the six-section template. If it is refused, fix what the refusal names and submit again.

doc_reviewer.name: get_doc
doc_reviewer.description: Read a design document: the latest of a kind, one version, or the review draft your first message names (draft).

doc_reviewer.name: submit_findings
doc_reviewer.description: Submit your review's findings once, then stop. Use blocking only for placeholders, contradictions, untestable requirements, scope beyond the approved approach, dropped brainstorm decisions, a requirement without an acceptance check, or a plan task that does not deliver its covers.
